items.title: METR: AI R&D capabilities improving fast and getting harder to measure
items.summary: METR's Q4 2026 capability update says the 50% time horizon of frontier models doubles roughly every 3.6 months (95% CI 2.08-4.94). The verifiable-task suite TH2 alone shows about 1.65 months. Models match or beat skilled humans on coding and optimization tasks with clear scoring, but have weaker judgment on open-ended tasks, and model judges overrate model outputs. METR concludes that public evidence cannot rule out drastic AI R&D acceleration within a couple of years.
items.why_it_matters: Independent evaluator data on how quickly AI agents improve at research-type work.

items.title: Embodied AI launches AIR, a humanoid designed to work safely alongside people
items.summary: Swiss company Embodied AI unveiled the humanoid AIR at Humanoid Europe 2026, pitched as physically safe and able to learn on the job in factories shared with humans. Seen only via search summary.
items.why_it_matters: European push to build humanoids with safety as the selling point.
